The Goblins' Betrayal

While the warriors were away, previously friendly goblins raided the camp and captured the chief's wife. Urk-Tar is wounded and cannot rescue her himself. He should be grateful for your help.

Objectives

Go to the goblin camp

Find the chief's wife

Rescue Urk-Tar's wife

The chief's wife must survive

Locations

Maps
Middle Mountains

Authored rewards

PropertyValue
Experience700.0
Gold500.0

These are the authored base rewards. Scripts, choices and game rules can change the final reward.
